metadata.goal: Read a JSON file and produce a data quality report listing null values and type inconsistencies per top-level key, with a read-only reviewer step validating findings before the final report is written
metadata.platform_note: Tier 1 (Claude Code): agents are zero-body YAML frontmatter files with companion protocol skills. Reviewer isolation is structural via worktree + disallowedTools + permissionMode:plan.

steps.description: Reads the input JSON file, checks each top-level value for null and type inconsistency issues, writes structured findings JSON to the temp directory.

Reads analyzer findings, validates schema completeness and correctness. READ-ONLY: disallowedTools Write,Edit,Bash + permissionMode:plan enforces structural write-deny via CC host. Verdict via terminal output text.
Reads findings and reviewer verdict from context, renders the final markdown data quality report, writes the output file.
